name: Better Via Stitching
description: Fast, DRC-safe via stitching for zones (rectangular or hexagonal grid) and via fencing along selected tracks.
description_full:
Via stitching and track fencing for KiCad PCB editor.

- Rectangular or hexagonal stitching grids for any net with a zone
- Track fencing along selected tracks and arcs, continuous around bends
- Grid alignment optimisation fits more vias around pads and existing vias
- Respects copper, hole and edge clearances, via keepouts, copper text and graphics
- Never pinches other nets' planes below the minimum connection width and keeps thermal-relief spokes intact
- Profiles for general, thermal and RF (lambda/20 pitch) stitching
- Reports how many positions were rejected and why

Based on the ViaStitching plugin by Jean-Samuel Reynaud and contributors.
